sections.title: One word, several jobs
sections.content: *Tessék* changes meaning with its situation: handing something to someone, it means "here you are"; as a question, *Tessék?*, it means "pardon?" — a polite way to ask someone to repeat themselves.

You'll hear *tessék* constantly in shops and cafés — often as the very first word said to you, meaning something closer to "how can I help?" or "go ahead." Context, and the rising or falling tone, always tells the jobs apart.
